title: Navigate from GIS back to the launcher and into API Request Audit
affectedSection: Navigating between GIS, the launcher, and API Request Audit
steps: Open GIS from the V4 launcher.
Use the browser Back control to return to the V4 launcher.
Open API Request Audit from its launcher card.
reason: Document the verified navigation from GIS back to the launcher and onward to the API Request Audit dashboard.
